name: Benchtop drill press: set up and drill a 13 mm hole

steps.title: Main switch ON
steps.spokenInstruction: Turn the main switch to ON.
steps.rationale: The main switch connects the drill to mains power. Nothing runs without it.

steps.title: Release E-STOP
steps.spokenInstruction: Release the red emergency stop button.
steps.rationale: The motor cannot start while the emergency stop is pressed in.

steps.title: Select the 13 mm bit
steps.rationale: The job needs a 13 mm hole, so the bit must match.

steps.title: Set speed to LOW
steps.spokenInstruction: Set the spindle speed to LOW.
steps.rationale: A large bit must turn slowly. Too fast overheats the bit and can ruin the part.

steps.title: Place the part
steps.spokenInstruction: Place the aluminium plate on the table.
steps.rationale: The plate sits flat on the table under the bit.

steps.title: Clamp the part
steps.spokenInstruction: Close the clamp to lock the plate.
steps.rationale: A loose plate can spin with the bit and cause injury. Never hold it by hand.

steps.title: Set depth stop to 20 mm
steps.spokenInstruction: Set the depth stop to 20 millimetres.
steps.rationale: The plate is 25 mm thick. A 20 mm stop drills a blind hole and keeps the bit away from the table.

steps.title: Lower the safety guard
steps.rationale: The guard stops chips and keeps hands and hair away from the spinning bit.

steps.title: Cutting oil ON
steps.rationale: Oil keeps the bit cool and the cut clean.

steps.title: Start the motor
steps.rationale: The bit only turns when the motor runs. It needs the guard down and the part clamped first.

steps.title: Drill the hole
steps.spokenInstruction: Pull the feed lever down slowly to drill the hole, then let it return.
steps.rationale: A steady feed cuts cleanly. The depth stop ends the hole at 20 mm.

steps.title: Stop the motor
steps.spokenInstruction: Press the motor button to stop the bit.
steps.rationale: Always let the bit stop before you touch anything.

steps.title: Raise the guard
steps.rationale: Only open the guard once the bit has stopped.
